correctness.rationale: Periodizing the infinite-line solution gives the stated Green entries. In the sum of two independent class-supported probes, each monochromatic unordered pair contributes exactly four times its squared Green entry. The positive discrete second differences decompose the Ising energy into a positive magnetization term and positive window-square terms. Odd windows have squares at least one; even windows satisfy the summed bound W_k ≥ 2k|S| ≥ 2k. Single-defect alternation attains the bounds jointly; the strictly positive W_2 coefficient forces exactly one defect at equality, including n=5. Counting the d wraparound pairs yields the exact variance. The cross term 2r^n summed over at most O(n²) pairs, the reflected tail and the geometric truncations give the stated fixed-r remainder. The infinite-volume ratio and both fixed-order limits agree with the variance of the average of two full-support probes.
residual_risks: The exact replay is bounded, and the asymptotic error is at fixed positive screening, not uniform down to zero screening.
